name: Breeze Companion 0.3.3 — Remove custom voices
notes:
Companion 0.3.3 adds **Remove voice** so you can remove a specific added voice without undoing later additions or reference edits.

### Remove a custom voice

1. Open **Voices** and select the added custom voice.
2. Choose **Remove voice** and confirm.
3. Use **Undo last change** if you want to restore it.

The selected voice disappears immediately from Voices, Generate and API routing. Other voices and edits stay intact. Removal works with the model unloaded and persists across restarts and compatible updates. Stock characters, including those with replacement references, cannot be removed.

Pack snapshots and reference audio are retained for undo. This removes the voice from the active list; it does not permanently erase recordings or reclaim their disk space. Companion 0.3.2 only had Undo, which restores whole-pack changes in reverse order.

### Downloads and upgrade

| Platform | Companion archive |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x86_64 | `breeze-tts-pny-0.3.3-windows-x86_64.zip` |
| Linux x86_64 | `breeze-tts-pny-server-0.3.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

New installations also need **`breeze-pny-curated-voices-20261115.tar.gz`**, attached below. Windows includes Python and the native runtime; Linux needs Python 3.11+ and the documented system dependencies.

Upgrading from **0.3.0–0.3.2** reuses the same voice archive, models, patched 0.1.6 native runtime and game mod **0.1.3**. Stop Companion before updating:

- **Windows:** copy the new package contents into your existing package folder, preserving `companion/`, then run `setup.cmd --update`.
- **Linux:** from the new extracted folder, run `python3 installer/install.py --prefix /path/to/existing/installation --update`.

Setup preserves compatible custom voices and references, the selected model, and configured ports. Restart with your usual flags and open the new session link. The page header should read **0.3.3**. LAN hosting and named voice creation from 0.3.2 remain available. [Companion and upgrade guide](https://github.com/ponywizard/breeze-tts-pny/blob/v0.3.3/docs/COMPANION.md).

### Validation

- 85 Python tests pass on Linux and under bundled Windows Python/Wine (five expected Windows skips). Coverage includes older-voice removal while preserving later additions and edits, authentication, busy protection, unloaded operation, restart/update persistence, Undo, stock/invalid IDs and configuration-write failure.
- Chromium checks cover the actual confirmation and cancellation dialogs, list updates, reload and Undo, alongside the existing generation, reference, model, seed/direction and mobile workflows.
- Packaged upgrades from 0.3.2 pass on Linux and Windows/Wine: existing custom voices and configuration survive, the Q8 model is reused, and selective removal and Undo work through the installed LAN launchers. Removal persists after another update and restart with the model unloaded. Release archives pass the nested-archive audit.
- Native Windows browser/firewall/GPU and second-computer LAN checks remain with community testers. No new in-game/VR playtest or voice-quality claim is made.

[Validation details](https://github.com/ponywizard/breeze-tts-pny/blob/v0.3.3/docs/SERVER_VALIDATION.md). `SHA256SUMS`, build receipts and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` identify the published artifacts and source commit.
